summary: A runtime booted on a GitHub runner, ran a process and was deleted

steps.label: GitHub gave this job a runner
Read the account before touching it
Boomi issued a single-use installer token
Started Boomi's official runtime container (boomi/atom)
The runtime installed itself and answered its health check
Boomi shows the runtime ONLINE, attached to a test environment
Ran a deployed process on it: it fetched a public page and returned the document
Ran a process built to fail: Boomi reported the error, so a pass means something
Measured the runtime while it was up
Stopped the container and deleted the runtime from Boomi
Nothing left behind: the account is back where it started

summary: A trading partner was created, read, found and deleted through the API

steps.label: Read the account before touching it
Created an X12 trading partner with one API call (invented company: Penny Paperclip Stationers)
Read it back: the interchange id survived the round trip
Found it with a query, the way a pipeline would look one up
Deleted it, and the same query now finds nothing
No license was used: nothing was deployed

summary: A runner ran a live Flow app end to end: Flow, Integration and Data Integration answered

steps.label: Started the Flow app with no login, as a browser would
Landed on its first page and found the button
Pressed the button: Flow called Boomi Integration, which asked Boomi Data Integration
The page loaded live rows (zero rows would be a failure, not a pass)
Nothing was created, so there is nothing to remove
